parameters.query:
-- source_id and source_language are looked up from the sources table rather
-- than hardcoded, so pointing the crawler at another section needs no edit
-- here. An article that could not be fetched arrives with no text, and the
-- length check drops it instead of storing an empty row.
INSERT INTO items (source_id, source_url, canonical_url, title, publisher,
                   published_at, excerpt, raw_text, source_language, status)
SELECT s.id, $1, $1, $2, 'Suomen eOppimiskeskus ry', $3::timestamptz, $4, $5,
       s.language, 'new'
  FROM sources s
 WHERE s.active
   AND s.language = CASE WHEN $1 LIKE '%/en/%' THEN 'en' ELSE 'fi' END
   AND length($5) > 100
ON CONFLICT (canonical_url) DO UPDATE
   SET title        = EXCLUDED.title,
       excerpt      = EXCLUDED.excerpt,
       raw_text     = EXCLUDED.raw_text,
       published_at = EXCLUDED.published_at,
       fetched_at   = now();
